decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-ea4a77b80f71] says what changed: the Pebble version used by cert-manager's ACME end-to-end tests was upgraded to v2.7.0, and those tests were adjusted to match. The note is filed under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)". The change is limited to the project's own test suite and names no shipped component, setting or runtime behaviour. That is enough to write the applicability as no exposed customer environment, with consequence "none". The note gives no previous Pebble version, but the open applicability aspect does not depend on it.
